name: australian-litigation-deadlines
description: Map limitation periods and compute candidate procedural deadlines for Australian civil litigation using script-only date arithmetic, evidence-gated computation-rule tables, official-publisher sources and human-confirmation gates — every date is provisional until the responsible lawyer confirms it.

interface.shortDescription: Maps limitation periods and computes candidate court deadlines. A lawyer must confirm each date.
interface.longDescription: Creates a controlled litigation-deadline practice profile, maps described causes of action to candidate limitation periods across all nine Australian jurisdictions, computes candidate procedural and tribunal deadlines with a bundled deterministic script over evidence-gated computation-rule tables and verified holiday tables, verifies those tables against official publishers, and maintains a source-linked matter deadline register. The model never performs date arithmetic, unverified periods fail closed to identify-only output, and every date remains provisional until the responsible lawyer confirms it.
defaultPrompt: Create a controlled litigation-deadline practice profile before mapping or computing any deadlines.
Map the candidate limitation periods across Australian jurisdictions for this cause of action.
Compute the candidate procedural deadline for this trigger event using the bundled script and rule tables.
Map the merits-review and tribunal deadlines that could apply to this administrative decision.
Verify the deadline computation-rule tables and holiday tables against the official publishers.
Update this matter's deadline register with source-linked entries and confirmation status.
